tools.name: find_services
tools.description: List what HomeMaster sells in Singapore (home cleaning, aircon servicing), the options for each (cleaning visit lengths and how often; aircon jobs and unit counts) and their list prices in SGD, GST included. Call this first when you need the options. For an exact price with offers, use get_quote.

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Check whether a service is available at a Singapore postal code, before looking for times. Coverage depends on which cleaners or technicians work near the address.

tools.name: find_times
tools.description: Find real open dates, or start times on one date, for a booking at a postal code. Without `date`: the open dates in the next 14 days. tools.description: Get the price the checkout will show a new customer, with any evening rate or public voucher it applies.
